## Summary

One sentence: what do you want to add or change?

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Which use case does it enable?

## Proposed solution

Describe your proposed approach. If you have code in mind, sketch it out.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you ruled them out.

## Scope

Which component does this touch?
- [ ] Scheduling simulator (`src/vllm_evolve/simulation/`)
- [ ] KV eviction simulator
- [ ] Scheduling seeds (`targets/scheduling/seeds/`)
- [ ] KV eviction seeds
- [ ] Fitness formula (`src/vllm_evolve/fitness.py`)
- [ ] Evolution loop (`run_generation.py`)
- [ ] CLI (`src/vllm_evolve/cli.py`)
- [ ] Benchmarks
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other
